wire_contract: Semantic inputs only; bind to finalized accepted DTOs before execution, no proposed enum is asserted implemented
execution_contract: Each future run preserves exact source/contract/supplier/fixture identities, ordered events, observed UI and call/effect counts, source hashes, environment/commands/exits, screenshots/assets and cleanup; component tests plus native/supplier proof as required. Test each layout at1440/960 light/dark for relevant UI, keyboard/focus and primary draft preservation.

fixtures.name: Child versus broker versus human
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: One attributed child C under parent P asks via broker B; authenticated human H responds.
fixtures.oracle: Display C as requesting actor, P/root context; B only broker details; retained decision attributes H. No role inferred; intent distinct from delivery.

fixtures.name: Resolved before attribution
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Request ID is resolved before join; child association then arrives; stale view may be delivered.
fixtures.oracle: Never actionable after resolution; no grant/send; disabled stale view; no invented decision. Includes mandatory CORRECTION_V2.

fixtures.name: Advertised dialect and session scope
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Request offers accept/cancel but not decline; session scope proof absent; protocol may be unsupported.
fixtures.oracle: No Deny or session grant; cancel not mapped to deny; accurate protocol/unavailable; separate Stop remains distinct.

fixtures.name: Background request root binding
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Request belongs to A; user selects chat/root B before reviewing/responding.
fixtures.oracle: A clearly identified; no rebinding, no B authority; preflight/respond use authoritative A identity.

fixtures.name: Dismissal
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Close a pending approval view without another action.
fixtures.oracle: Zero grant/deny/stop calls; no synthesized terminal; request remains discoverable if still current.

fixtures.name: Double click and intent persistence
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Click Allow twice; first intent persists while response is reserved.
fixtures.oracle: At most one effective send; UI locks; decision recorded displayed only on actual persistence evidence; no applied claim.

fixtures.name: Send uncertainty
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Intent persists; enqueue has backpressure/error, or succeeds without supplier acknowledgement.
fixtures.oracle: Unknown versus sent/application-unconfirmed correctly distinguished; no Retry/replay or false denial; history preserved.

fixtures.name: Retirement stale click
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: View published then child ends or generation retires before user response.
fixtures.oracle: Server rejects stale response; UI disables/refreshes; cause preserved; no old authority revival or invented terminal.

fixtures.name: Recovery
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Restart sees incomplete delivery/settlement journal and old request history.
fixtures.oracle: Recovery-required shown; history read-only when entitled; no in-flight reattach/replay or duplicate send.

fixtures.name: Old/unknown negotiated representation
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Old consumer or unknown approval representation encounters child request.
fixtures.oracle: Feature unavailable rather than primary-shaped downgrade; unrelated supported controls remain functional.

fixtures.name: Stop current work
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Pending background child request; user explicitly clicks Stop current work with consequence text.
fixtures.oracle: Names originating conversation; requests whole-turn stop once; preserves history/draft; no Deny claim; stopped only after observed outcome.

fixtures.name: Stop delayed or failed
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Stop request is pending, times out or has uncertain completion.
fixtures.oracle: Stopping then truthful failure/uncertainty; no optimistic stopped state, automatic retry or lost draft.

fixtures.name: Account versus readiness
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Global identity exists; active root lacks consent or needs sign-in.
fixtures.oracle: Identity visible; root missing step visible; execution not falsely ready; no global green readiness.

fixtures.name: Root/account continuity race
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Read A readiness; select B or switch account/epoch/policy before A response.
fixtures.oracle: Late A response cannot grant or repaint B; new readiness unknown until authoritative matching result.

fixtures.name: Logout scope
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Brokerage advertises only selected operation and explicit logout scope.
fixtures.oracle: UI states exact scope before act; pending until confirmed; no assumed cross-root revocation, token copying or custody effects.

fixtures.name: Isolated context absent versus ready
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: No folder with no accepted context; contrast future accepted explicit isolated context.
fixtures.oracle: Current absent contract blocks sending; accepted context uses its own identity/capabilities only; label Isolated chat; no ambient/recent root fallback.

fixtures.name: Project transition
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Existing isolated chat with history/draft selects a project.
fixtures.oracle: Recommended new session retains old history; explicit action; fresh validation/consent; no old grants; draft preservation without automatic send. Backend transition awaiting acceptance.

fixtures.name: Removed isolated context
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: History exists but context unavailable or deleted under accepted custody policy.
fixtures.oracle: Execution blocked and reason visible; read follows entitlement; no automatic recreation/replay; chat hide not treated as context deletion.

fixtures.name: Accept versus Adjust
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Current exact-content proposal; user adjusts then reviews revised content.
fixtures.oracle: No acceptance on edit; new explicit review binds revised exact content; display authority/source/root; no lifecycle promotion from card.

fixtures.name: Proposal/content/instruction drift
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Proposal or source basis changes after view, before Accept.
fixtures.oracle: Stale click rejected; changed state/refreshed review; no unseen latest-content application, silent repin or auto-retry.

fixtures.name: Not now scope
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Decline prompt for trigger T in chat A; encounter T elsewhere.
fixtures.oracle: Accepted once-per-chat trigger semantics only; no global suppression or lifecycle mutation; no unrelated denial.

fixtures.name: Concurrent advancement and Bind
fixtures.setup_and_stimulus: Two actors advance same prior workflow hash; or copy accepted workflow to root B.
fixtures.oracle: Conflict visible; no second stale acceptance; new binding requires fresh authority, no copied approval acceptance.
